original_question:
Design Verilog modules for a 1-bit full adder and a 4-bit ripple-carry adder constructed from four instances of the 1-bit full adder.

For the 1-bit full adder, the module name must be `fullAdder` and its interface should be:
`module fullAdder(A, B, Cin, Sum, Cout);`
It takes three single-bit inputs `A`, `B`, and `Cin`, and produces a single-bit sum `Sum` and a single-bit carry-out `Cout`.

For the 4-bit ripple-carry adder, the module name must be `rippleCarryAdder` and its interface should be:
`module rippleCarryAdder(A, B, Cin, Sum, Cout);`
It takes two 4-bit inputs `A` and `B`, a single-bit carry-in `Cin`, and produces a 4-bit sum `Sum` and a single-bit carry-out `Cout`. This module should instantiate four `fullAdder` modules and connect them in a ripple-carry configuration.
